title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Your tweet was funny last night
THE STEP CHICKENS HAVE RUINED ME
I liked it but I was high so I unliked it right away
Which is to say, I was paranoid, like, “I don’t want them seeing me liking his tweet.”
I’ve thought about pissing off Ben and just tweeting “Anthony Fenech is my good friend and we have the best phone calls ❤️”
Loved “I’ve thought about pissing off Ben and just tweeting “Anthony Fenech is my good friend and we have the best phone calls ❤️””
